records.question: Which five sellers with at least fifty reviews have the lowest average review score?

  SELECT seller_id, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS num_reviews

  JOIN order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id

LIMIT 5
